app.title: Mask Drill
home.heading: Mask Drill
home.intro: A 10-minute drill for emergency response teams. You lead a team of four during a suspected Nipah case. Pick the right mask, reject bad stock, get a good seal, check your teammates, and take everything off without contaminating yourself.
home.score: Your score is the team's average protection. One teammate with a leaking mask pulls the whole team down, so checking each other matters as much as your own fit.
home.disclaimer: Training aid only. Always follow your hospital or state infection-control protocol. Works offline after the first visit.
home.comingSoon: The drill itself is being built. Check back soon.
